about.title: About
about.description: Hi! I'm Daniel, a frontend developer passionate about building modern and interactive web applications. What started as simple curiosity about how websites work quickly became a commitment to creating clean and engaging digital experiences.
about.description2: One of my proudest moments has been seeing real users interact with products I helped build. I enjoy crafting responsive interfaces with modern tools, focusing on usability, performance, and clarity in every detail.
about.description3: Outside of coding, I’m constantly learning and refining my skills. I believe in simplicity—writing clean, maintainable code and building interfaces that are intuitive, scalable, and built to last.

projects.title: Featured
projects.subtitle: Some of my best work
projects.description-p1: A digital platform for managing construction materials, featuring a robust administrative panel. I implemented workflow efficiency improvements, increasing price and availability update speed by 25% and optimizing customer request management by 30%. Developed with modern technologies that ensure scalability, efficiency, and high performance for users.
projects.description-p2: Comprehensive administrative software that simplifies sales, accounting, and inventory management for businesses, offering practical tools to improve productivity and operational control. It includes modules for sales, purchasing, inventory, customers, and accounting, with role-based controls and real-time reporting. I implemented improvements in data visualization and process optimization, achieving a 20% increase in operational efficiency and a 15% reduction in data entry errors.
projects.description-p3: It was a real estate management platform with a visual property catalog and Google Maps integration, allowing users to visualize locations and delimit land using polygonal lines. It included a comprehensive administration panel with role-based controls for managing properties, images, and availability, as well as real-time information on sales and lot status. I implemented multilingual support for contacts in three languages and editing tools that improved content management efficiency by 25%, optimizing business processes and the user experience.
projects.description-p4: It was a mobile life insurance app designed for university students and policyholders, allowing them to request medical services remotely via video calls. It included role-based access control and user management features, ensuring that information was displayed correctly for each user profile. I worked on the mobile front-end using Ionic, implementing loading screens, login screens, complete redesigns, and fixing data rendering errors, guaranteeing performance, scalability, and a smooth user experience.
